messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Ibuprofen is a very common medicine that raises potassium.
Some blood pressure tablets are very common medicines that raise potassium.
This risk is manageable.
Blood tests are built into treatment.
Your potassium should be checked within a week of starting spironolactone or changing your dose.
It should be checked regularly after that.
Spironolactone also needs care in pregnancy and in people with liver disease.
Triplet: ["spironolactone", "requires care in", "pregnancy"]

The relation 'requires care in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires special medical attention or caution in the condition or group of people specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
B. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
